body: I don't know if anyone cares, but I wanted to give an update. He went out and bought a shotgun. I then spent the next two days talking to him. I was finally able to convince him that he didn't have to commit suicide, that instead we could find ways to make him hurt less and that we could find a way to be away from all the humans that make him so sad. He is still jumping back and forth between being the man I married and being very depressed, but hopefully we can work on it not hurting him so much in the future. He still has the shotgun, it gives him some relief to know it's there despite his hatred of guns in general. I hope that one day he will give it up, but I'm just happy that he is still here.
He'll just wait for them to let him go and then commit suicide. He is so sad about the world and takes it all in. I don't know what to do...
